business_summary: Tokyo Cosmos Electric Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells electronic components in Japan, Asia, North America, and Europe. The company offers TOCOS film heaters, automotive devices, target simulators, PTC film heater for BEVS, and PTC heaters for automotive cameras, and potentiometer for industrial and consumer. It serves automobile and motorcycle, agriculture and construction, two-way radio, industrial, amusement, infrastructure, office and home, and healthcare sectors. In addition, it provides accessories. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Zama, Japan.
